st: The modern individual between sped-up songs, calorie tracking and the evolution of the species

sec.p: Since we have less and less time, everything has to go faster. Including, above all, WhatsApp voice notes and YouTube podcasts.

sec.t: ff.68.2 Ever more measured and controlled
sec.p: We measure everything, and I'm the first to do it. Sleep. Calories. Blood sugar. HRV (what? heart rate variability). Step count. Instagram followers. ff subscribers.

sec.t: ff.68.3 There's no limit to better (or to worse?)
sec.p: Seasoning the recipe of modern anxiety: the endless raising of the bar.

sec.t: ff.68.4 Less ego and control, more flow and presence: Naval's cure
sec.p: Before the summer I left you with a 2017 (!) podcast with Naval Ravikant (here's the transcript).
